en.title: Is Possible
en.description:
Starting from a pair of positive integers (a,b), you may repeatedly apply (a,b)→(a+b,b) or (a,b)→(a,a+b). Determine whether the target pair of positive integers (c,d) can be obtained; zero operations are allowed.

This site's input format and explicitly marked ranges are compiled by CSWork and do not pose as the original OA platform's I/O.
en.input: A single line containing a b c d. Original range: 1≤a,b,c,d≤1000.
en.output: Output Yes if reachable, otherwise output No.
en.explanation: See the accompanying solution for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: Work backward from (c,d). If c>d, the only possible predecessor is (c−d,d); if d>c, the only possible predecessor is (c,d−c). Subtract the smaller coordinate each time; if a coordinate drops below the start, or the state reaches equal coordinates that are not the start, the target is unreachable.
